levels.name: Platform level (OSM level 1): island platform 1/2 and platform 3
levels.note: All three platforms are korkea (0.55 m class) in Digitraffic; lengths 324 m (1), 320 m (2), 320 m (3). Digitraffic's record for platform 2 is valid from 2023-11-17. answers.question: Levels' real names as signposted
answers.answer: Not settled: no source names them. OSM: tunnel 0, platforms 1.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: From the tunnel at the east end of the station building: lift + stairs to island platform 1/2 and lift + stairs to platform 3 (OSM). VR confirms a signposted step-free route with a lift through the tunnel.

answers.question: Missing entrances
answers.answer: Station building on Asemakatu 1; Matkakeskus/bus-station doors at Puutarhakatu 3; parking-hall exits Puutarhakatu 11 and 15 (indoor link to the station by day only).

answers.question: Missing hours
answers.answer: Waiting room (VR) and R-kioski (own site) settled; café/restaurant/florist from OSM only; Pubi, car rentals without hours.

open: Level heights: no source measures them; the laser pass flags platform 1 at 0.92 m above the track bed vs class 0.55 m (see REVIEW).
Whether platform 1 is the island between tracks 1 and 2 (as the OSM lift position suggests) or an edge platform at the station building: not confirmed by any owner text or plan.
Second lift (n13343111135, platform 3) is OSM only; VR mentions one lift.
Which floor the station building, the Matkakeskus hall and the street are on relative to the tunnel (OSM gives no level).
Opening date of the new Matkakeskus (end of January 2021) is known only from a consultant (WSP) page, not an allowed source; not used.
Bar & Cafe Asema, Ravintola Portti, Linjurin Kukka, Pubi, K-Supermarket Portti: own-website hours not checked (web search budget ran out during this pass).
Väylävirasto station-area map (asemien lähialuekartat) could not be fetched.
Toilet fee not given by any source; taxi rank position not given (VR only advertises a taxi discount).
